## Description

Screens candidate partners on compliance (sanctions, anti-corruption history — not optional, since a partner's exposure transfers to us), financial stability/capacity, and dependency risk including the risk the partner becomes a competitor after technology transfer. Mandatory Partnership DD validators (`checklists/partnership-checklist.yaml` pt-02/pt-03/pt-04). Use when: "partner due diligence", "partner compliance screening", "sanctions screening for a partner", "post-transfer competitor risk".
